Balanced Flame Column.name: Balanced Flame Column
Balanced Flame Column.description: The user concentrates left-side fire into a jet reaching fifteen meters while cooling their body with right-side ice for up to three turns. It deals heavy fire damage each turn; held back, it cuts off an empty approach instead of striking people. Cooling delays overheating but does not prevent it, and the user needs a clear firing lane free of allies. Strain: severe.
